user_story: As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I enter a new todo in the input field with the selector 'input[data-testid="text-input"]' and press Enter, the todo should be added to the list. 2. When I check the checkbox with the selector 'input[data-testid="toggle-all"]', all todos should be marked as completed. 3. When I click the button with the class 'clear-completed', all completed todos should be removed from the list.
